headline: Where Did Investors Go at the Government Bond Auction? Demand for Treasury Bills Weakens
summary: Demand for 3-month discount treasury bills fell compared with last week at the Hungarian debt agency's Tuesday auction. Yields on the bills also fell at the sale.
why: Treasury bill auctions show how investors price short-term government debt, and shifts in demand signal changes in market sentiment toward sovereign borrowing.
